pain_points.statement: Finance is significantly delayed on invoicing due to data discrepancies.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

pain_points.statement: A large amount of working capital is tied up in unbilled receivables.
pain_points.source_excerpt: frees up about $1.4M in working capital that's currently stuck in unbilled receivables.

desired_state.statement: The company wants to return to an industry-standard Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).
desired_state.source_excerpt: return to five-day DSO from where we are now

desired_state.statement: The CFO requires a fixed-fee engagement structure with milestone-based payments.
desired_state.source_excerpt: fixed-fee proposal with milestone payments tied to specific outcomes

success_criteria.statement: The project must free up $1.4M in working capital.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: frees up about $1.4M in working capital

success_criteria.statement: The project must save $320k by avoiding the need to hire additional dispatchers.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: we don't need to hire four additional dispatchers next year, which is about $320k

risks_unknowns.statement: There is a disagreement regarding the maximum budget for the Phase 1 engagement.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: budget I approved is $300,000. That's the cap.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: CFO Rita insists on a strict $300k cap, while VP Ops Sarah claims they discussed a $250k-$400k range.

risks_unknowns.statement: Failure to meet ELD compliance could result in fines or loss of operating authority.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Fines, possibly losing our operating authority in some states.

pain_points.statement: The legacy dispatch system has severe technical debt making it fragile.
pain_points.source_excerpt: We can't ship features anymore because the codebase is too fragile.

pain_points.statement: Development velocity is severely hindered by the current architecture.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Every change takes three times as long as it should.

desired_state.statement: Stakeholders disagree on whether to replace the legacy dispatch system or patch its workflows.
desired_state.source_excerpt: replace Routemaster with a SaaS platform
desired_state.contradiction_note: CTO Marcus wants a full SaaS replacement, while VP Ops Sarah wants incremental workflow fixes on the existing platform.

desired_state.statement: Workflow logic should be built to survive a potential future platform replacement.
desired_state.source_excerpt: 60-70% of the Phase 1 work survives a platform change.

success_criteria.statement: The CTO must review and sign off on the proposed architecture.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: I want to be in the room when you walk through the architecture.

risks_unknowns.statement: Previous internal attempts to fix the workflow issues have failed.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We've tried internal projects to fix this exact thing twice and they both failed.

risks_unknowns.statement: Changes to the driver app may conflict with ongoing ELD compliance work.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: If we're going to touch the driver app, the ELD work has to be coordinated.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers suffer from excessive manual double-entry between systems.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce

pain_points.statement: The current mobile application is highly disliked by the drivers.

desired_state.statement: Operations wants to significantly reduce the time it takes to dispatch a load.
desired_state.source_excerpt: 30% reduction in dispatch time per load

success_criteria.statement: A pilot must be in production by the end of Q3 to secure funding.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: If we don't have something in production by end of September, the funding gets reallocated.

risks_unknowns.statement: There is a conflict regarding the feasibility of the Q3 pilot deadline.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: I think Q4 is more realistic if we're doing it right.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: VP Ops and CFO mandate a Q3 pilot for budget reasons, but the CTO believes Q4 is the realistic timeline.

pain_points.statement: Technical integration from recent company acquisitions remains incomplete.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

desired_state.statement: Any new development must not interfere with upcoming federal compliance mandates.
desired_state.source_excerpt: whatever we build needs to not get in the way of the compliance work.

success_criteria.statement: The company must meet the federal ELD compliance deadline in November.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: The ELD compliance deadline in November is real.

risks_unknowns.statement: The exact scope and technical requirements of the ELD compliance work are currently unknown to the consultant.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: I need to learn more about the ELD work before I can speak to that.
